subject: expressive TTS system
source_sentence: The ideal expressive TTS system should be able to handle any kind and any number of expressiveness without requiring costly labeling or manipulations every time we want to add any new one.
title: Continuous Expressive Speaking Styles Synthesis based on CVSM and MR-HMM
section: 3 Expressive Speech Synthesis based on CVSM and MR-HMM

subject: adaptation
source_sentence: there is no traditional adaptation process involved in the system, but a MR-HMM adaptation that takes the CVSM projections of each training text file as the control vector ⃗x′ for a training process that outputs a new model that combines both neutral and expressive information.
title: Continuous Expressive Speaking Styles Synthesis based on CVSM and MR-HMM

subject: Synthesis
source_sentence: This process is then capable of producing an expressive speech output without relying in any genre prediction system, only in the CVSM projections of the synthesis texts.
title: Continuous Expressive Speaking Styles Synthesis based on CVSM and MR-HMM

subject: Models
source_sentence: Regarding the speaker models, the whole train section of SSS database and the neutral speech of the same speaker present in SEV database were modeled into an average voice model (AVM) by applying Speaker Adaptive Training (SAT) with three feature streams with their ∆and ∆2 coefficients: logarithm of the fundamental frequency (1 coefficient), mel-cepstral analysis coefficients (MCEP, 60 coefficients) and aperiodicity bands (25 coefficients).
title: Continuous Expressive Speaking Styles Synthesis based on CVSM and MR-HMM

subject: Models
source_sentence: The models were adapted by means of the CSMAPLR algorithm .
